Image Duotone

Map any photo's tones to two colors you pick for a striking duotone effect.

🖼️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. Pick a shadow color and a highlight color.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the duotone mapping work?

Each pixel's brightness is used to blend between your shadow color and your highlight color.

Is the preview live?

Yes — use the color pickers and the preview updates live.

What format is the download?

A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.
